title: [29.X]-VAT Settlement G/L Entries Do Not Populate Source Currency Amount and Source VAT Currency Amount After Running Calculate and Post VAT Settlement
summary: Fixed VAT settlement calculations to properly populate source currency amount and source VAT currency amount in G/L entries when posting VAT settlements.
key_points: Source currency amounts were not being set in G/L entries created by the Calculate and Post VAT Settlement report
Fix applied consistently across multiple localizations (AU, BE, ES, IT, NO, W1)
Test cases added to validate that currency amounts are correctly populated
Changes made to the VAT Settlement report logic for handling multi-currency scenarios
